title: Rapid Processing and Immunohistochemistry Method for Optimising Diagnosis Time in Solid Organ Donors, Suspected Malignancy
official: Rapid Processing and Immunohistochemistry Method for Optimising Diagnosis Time in Solid Organ Donors With Suspected Malignancy
summary: Comparison of the diagnostic yield of intra-operative histological analysis of donor tissue with suspected neoplasia performed with the standard method versus the experimental method, which involves optimisation of sample freezing and analysis with the IHC fast track procedure
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Organ donors (legally dead by brain or cardiac death) with suspected neoplasia.
* Sending organs/tissues of all types and locations for extemporaneous examination request

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
